verdict.rationale: Pika's own materials describe a programmatic API: 'Pika API Club', billed as 'One API for 100+ leading video, image, audio, and LLM models' and a membership program giving model access 'all through one API'. The pack only has marketing-level descriptions, though. It shows no API reference, endpoints, authentication scheme or SDK, and does not say whether Pika's own creative apps (as opposed to third-party models) can be driven this way. Missing for 10: published API reference docs, auth and endpoint details, confirmation that Pika's own apps are reachable via the API, independent or hands-on corroboration.
